reports.name: Annual PIT return
reports.description: Poland annual PIT filing window for the 2025 income year.

workflows.name: Review Twoj e-PIT data
workflows.description: Review pre-filled income, reliefs, child relief, filing status, and payments before submitting the annual PIT return.

workflows.name: Submit annual PIT return
workflows.description: Submit the annual PIT return during the 15 February to 30 April filing window.

workflows.name: Settle annual PIT balance
workflows.description: Pay the annual PIT balance by the annual return deadline when the return produces tax due.

events.title: 2025 annual PIT submission deadline
events.description: Annual PIT returns for 2025 income are submitted between 15 February and 30 April 2026.

events.title: 2025 annual PIT payment deadline
events.description: Any annual PIT balance for the 2025 return is generally paid by 30 April 2026.

reports.name: KSeF rollout
reports.description: Poland KSeF mandatory structured-invoice rollout checkpoints for 2026.

workflows.name: Assess KSeF scope
workflows.description: Determine whether the taxpayer is in the large-taxpayer, ordinary taxpayer, or small-invoice transition group.

workflows.name: Configure KSeF access
workflows.description: Set up KSeF authentication, permissions, invoice schema handling, and accounting-system integration before the relevant obligation date.

events.title: KSeF mandatory start for large taxpayers
events.description: KSeF structured invoicing becomes mandatory from 1 February 2026 for taxpayers whose 2024 sales exceeded PLN 200 million gross.

events.title: KSeF mandatory start for other taxpayers
events.description: KSeF structured invoicing becomes mandatory from 1 April 2026 for other covered taxpayers, subject to transition rules.

events.title: KSeF small-invoice transition end
events.description: The 2026 small monthly invoice-value transition ends on 1 January 2027 for taxpayers covered by that deferral.
